name: io.github.auzroz/ynab-mcp
title: YNAB Budget Assistant
description: Full YNAB API coverage plus spending analytics, for self-hosted use with Claude.

environmentVariables.name: YNAB_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your YNAB Personal Access Token. Get one at https://app.ynab.com/settings/developer

environmentVariables.name: YNAB_BUDGET_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default budget ID to use when not specified. Optional; uses 'last-used' if not set.

environmentVariables.name: YNAB_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to disable all write operations (create, update, delete). Defaults to true for safety.
